$comment: What the weekly health check watches that no package manager knows about.
runtimes:    products and release cycles from endoflife.date, e.g. nodejs 22.
credentials: secrets you rotate by hand. Record rotatedOn (YYYY-MM-DD) when you do;
null means nobody has written it down yet.
unreachable: advisories you have checked by hand cannot be reached from a request,
each with a reason and a date. They are still reported, just not counted.
pinned:      packages deliberately held to a release line (e.g. @types/node).
versions:    packages whose declared version should be listed in the report.
